summary: Henry County's Georgia Forestry Commission tower, listed as greenwood, was sold; a 2012 plan moved it to Reynolds Nature Preserve near Morrow, not confirmed on site.

facts.status_note: A 2012 plan moved it to the Reynolds Nature Preserve near Morrow; the move is not confirmed on site.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLA 2012 report gives the model as LS-40 and the Forest Lookouts index gives MC-40; both describe a 100-foot Aermotor, so the design field leaves the model out.

The FFLA 2012 report describes a plan, the Forest Lookouts index says the tower will be relocated, and the tnlandforms Reynolds entry marks it relocated. No source confirms completion, so status is relocated with a caveat.

notes_for_editor: Name link: the record's greenwood is tnlandforms code GA109 (Henry County; GFC 407; BLL 65649). No source read calls the Henry County tower greenwood. The link rests on the county, the GA109 code on the Reynolds list entry, and the 2012 Henry County report. The move to Reynolds is planned in 2012 and marked relocated on the list, but no source confirms the tower stands there, so the status is relocated with a caveat. A human could check with Clayton County Parks and Recreation. Built year and tower-specific staffing were not found in any source read. The statewide air-patrol context comes from one Vanishing Georgia tag page. No photos found. Brief status unknown was replaced by relocated on list evidence.
